Run the overall verification list and the Phase 2 block; full `ossctl doctor`; one research-profile scout or reviewer job (dry-run, read-only) whose events show a successful `@github/...` read tool call (GHMCP-2 in-container path); the real Windows restart test of 6a/6b (needs the user to restart the laptop: ask with a workflow warning, then record the observed shutdown types); confirm every TRACEABILITY row is `done` or `deferred`; write `docs/FINAL_REPORT.md` (summary, doctor results, live checks, user actions needed); commit.
